subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a repaired version of this draft serializer, or leave the PR waiting on the contributor?
rationale: The bug and proof are strong, but the branch is draft, conflicting, and needs non-trivial owner-boundary repair around canonical delivery lanes and stalled sends before it can land.

options.title: Repair before merge
options.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue and platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh proof.

options.title: Wait for author
options.body: Keep this PR open but require the contributor to rebase and address the existing findings before another merge-readiness review.

options.title: Close if not sponsored
options.body: Close the stale draft only if maintainers do not want to sponsor the larger repair despite the proven bug.

recommendation.title: Repair before merge
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue and platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The central repair should likely reuse or extend the keyed queue helper that vincentkoc recently hardened.
